recipes.name: Andalusian chilled tomato soup
recipes.description: A smooth cold summer soup of ripe tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, garlic and olive oil.
instructions: Roughly chop tomatoes, cucumber and pepper
soak bread in a little water
Blend vegetables, bread and garlic until smooth
With blender running add oil, vinegar, water and salt
Strain if desired and chill at least 2 hours
adjust seasoning cold.
recipes.sides: Serve with diced cucumber, pepper and bread.
recipes.substitutions: Omit bread for a gluten-free version.
recipes.storage: Keep covered and refrigerated; use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Wash vegetables well and keep soup chilled.

recipes.name: Asturian bean stew
recipes.description: Large white beans slowly cooked with smoked pork and paprika.
ingredients: 400 g dried fabes or butter beans, soaked overnight
instructions: Drain soaked beans and cover with fresh water in a heavy pot
Bring just to a simmer
add onion and bay, skim foam and cook very gently
Add chorizo, morcilla and pork after 45 minutes
keep barely simmering until beans are creamy and tender, adding cold water if needed
Season with paprika and rest 10 minutes before serving.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread and a light salad.
recipes.substitutions: Use canned large beans and simmer with meats for 30 minutes.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat gently.
recipes.safety: Soak beans refrigerated if needed; cook meat products fully.

recipes.name: Battered squid rings
recipes.description: Lightly battered squid rings fried until crisp and served with lemon.
instructions: Pat squid very dry and season
Whisk flour, egg, cold sparkling water and salt into a loose batter
Heat oil to 180 C
dip squid rings and fry in small batches for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and just cooked
Drain on a rack and serve immediately.
recipes.sides: Serve with lemon wedges and salad.
recipes.substitutions: Use chilled still water if sparkling water is unavailable.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; do not store battered leftovers.
recipes.safety: Keep squid chilled before frying; avoid overcrowding hot oil.

recipes.name: Broken eggs with potatoes
recipes.description: Crisp potatoes topped with soft fried eggs that are broken just before eating.
instructions: Parboil potatoes 5 minutes, drain and steam dry
Fry potatoes in a wide pan with oil over medium heat, turning until golden and tender
Cook onion alongside until soft
Fry eggs separately until whites are set and yolks remain soft
Pile potatoes and onion onto a platter, top with eggs and break yolks at table.
recipes.sides: Serve with salad or cured ham.
recipes.substitutions: Use roasted potatoes for less oil.
recipes.storage: Serve immediately; refrigerate leftovers and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs to a safe doneness for vulnerable diners.

recipes.name: Cabbage and potato mash
recipes.description: Cabbage and potatoes mashed together and crisped with garlic and bacon.
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender
add cabbage for final 8 minutes
drain well
Fry bacon in oil until crisp
remove and reserve
add garlic and cook briefly
Mash potatoes and cabbage roughly
fold through garlic oil and bacon
Press mixture into pan and brown both sides like a thick cake.
recipes.sides: Serve with fried egg or salad.
recipes.substitutions: Omit bacon and use smoked paprika.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days; reheat in a pan.
recipes.safety: Cook bacon thoroughly and chill leftovers quickly.

recipes.name: Castilian garlic soup
recipes.description: Bread and garlic soup flavoured with paprika, often finished with egg.
instructions: Warm oil in a pot and gently cook garlic until pale gold
Stir in bread and paprika
toss until bread is coated
Pour in stock and simmer 15 minutes until bread softens
crack in eggs and poach gently until whites set
season.
recipes.sides: Serve hot with extra paprika.
recipes.substitutions: Use vegetable stock and omit eggs for a simple vegan soup.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 2 days and reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs fully, especially for vulnerable diners.

recipes.name: Catalan black rice
recipes.description: Rice cooked with squid, stock and squid ink for a savoury coastal dish.
instructions: Warm stock
brown squid briefly in oil and set aside
Cook onion and pepper until soft
add garlic, rice and ink, stirring to coat
Add hot stock and simmer without stirring 18 minutes
return squid for final 3 minutes
rest covered 5 minutes.
recipes.sides: Serve with lemon and alioli.
recipes.substitutions: Use cuttlefish and a little extra ink if needed.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 1 day; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Use fresh squid from a reliable source and cook through.

recipes.name: Catalan burnt cream
recipes.description: Citrus-scented custard finished with a crisp layer of caramelised sugar.
instructions: Warm milk with cinnamon and lemon peel
remove from heat and steep 10 minutes
Whisk yolks, sugar and cornflour
slowly whisk in warm milk
Strain into a clean pan and stir over low heat until thick
do not boil
Pour into dishes and chill at least 3 hours
sprinkle sugar and caramelise with a torch just before serving.
recipes.sides: Serve with crisp biscuits.
recipes.substitutions: Use orange peel instead of lemon.
recipes.storage: Cover and refrigerate up to 2 days before caramelising.
recipes.safety: Keep custard chilled; avoid serving if left warm for over 2 hours.

recipes.name: Churros
recipes.description: Ridged fried dough sticks rolled in sugar and served with thick hot chocolate.
instructions: Bring water, butter, sugar and salt to a boil. Remove from heat and stir in flour until a smooth dough forms.
Cool 10 minutes; spoon dough into a sturdy piping bag with a star nozzle.
Heat oil to 175 C. Pipe short lengths carefully into oil, snipping with scissors; fry in batches until golden and crisp.
Drain briefly and roll in cinnamon sugar; serve with hot chocolate.
recipes.sides: Serve with thick hot chocolate for dipping.
recipes.substitutions: Omit butter and use water-only dough for a simpler version.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; do not keep cooked churros in a sealed container.
recipes.safety: Use a deep stable pan and monitor hot oil; never pipe over the pan.

recipes.name: Cod in Biscayan pepper sauce
recipes.description: Cod served with a slowly cooked red pepper, onion and tomato sauce.
instructions: If using salt cod, desalinate under refrigeration following supplier timing; pat dry.
Cook onion and peppers slowly in olive oil until very soft, about 20 minutes; add garlic and paprika.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes; blend if desired. Nestle cod into sauce, cover and cook gently until opaque and flakes easily.
recipes.sides: Serve with boiled potatoes or bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use fresh hake or pollock instead of cod.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 1 day; reheat gently until steaming.
recipes.safety: Keep fish chilled and cook until opaque and flakes easily.

recipes.name: Cod in garlic oil
recipes.description: Salt cod gently emulsified with olive oil, garlic and chilli into a glossy sauce.
ingredients: 4 desalted cod portions, about 150 g each
instructions: If using salt cod, soak in the refrigerator as directed by supplier and change water
Pat fish dry
gently warm oil with garlic and chilli until garlic turns pale gold
Remove garlic
add cod skin-side down and cook gently, moving pan in circles
Turn once and continue until fish flakes
Rest fish and whisk pan juices into a glossy emulsion
serve with garlic.
recipes.sides: Serve with boiled potatoes and bread.
recipes.substitutions: Fresh cod may be used; season lightly.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate cooked fish promptly and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Cook fish until opaque and flakes easily; keep raw fish chilled.

recipes.name: Cordoban thick tomato soup
recipes.description: A thick chilled blend of tomato, bread, garlic and olive oil, garnished with egg.
instructions: Blend chopped tomatoes and garlic until smooth
Add bread and leave 5 minutes to soften
blend again
With blender running, pour oil slowly until thick and creamy
add vinegar and salt
chill well
Top with chopped egg and optional ham.
recipes.sides: Serve with crusty bread.
recipes.substitutions: Skip ham for a vegetarian bowl.
recipes.storage: Keep chilled and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Use pasteurised or fully cooked egg; keep soup refrigerated.

recipes.name: Galician almond cake
recipes.description: A naturally flourless almond cake scented with lemon and cinnamon.
instructions: Heat oven to 175 C and line a 22 cm cake tin
Whisk eggs and sugar until pale
Fold in almonds, lemon zest and cinnamon without knocking out all air
Pour into tin and bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden and set
cool fully
dust with icing sugar.
recipes.sides: Serve with coffee or fruit.
recipes.substitutions: Use orange zest instead of lemon.
recipes.storage: Store covered at room temperature for 2 days.
recipes.safety: Bake until centre is set; cool before slicing.

recipes.name: Galician greens and bean soup
recipes.description: A sustaining soup of white beans, greens and potatoes, sometimes with pork.
ingredients: 200 g turnip greens or kale, chopped
instructions: Soften onion in oil in a soup pot
Add potatoes, stock and bay
simmer 15 minutes
Add beans and greens
simmer 20 minutes until potatoes break easily and greens are tender
mash a few beans to thicken
Season, remove bay and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve with crusty bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use spinach for greens and smoked paprika instead of pork.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Reheat soup thoroughly and stir well.

recipes.name: Galician octopus and potatoes
recipes.description: Tender octopus sliced over potatoes with olive oil and smoked paprika.
ingredients: 1 kg cleaned octopus, thawed if frozen
instructions: Bring a large pot of water and bay to a boil
dip octopus in and out three times to curl tentacles
Simmer gently 35 to 45 minutes until a knife enters thickest part easily
rest in cooking water 10 minutes
Boil potatoes separately until tender
slice onto a platter
Slice octopus over potatoes, drizzle oil and season with paprika and salt.
recipes.sides: Serve warm with bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use cooked octopus and warm briefly according to pack.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Keep seafood chilled and cook until tender and hot throughout.

recipes.name: Galician tuna pie
recipes.description: A large savoury pie with soft peppers, onion and tuna in a yeast crust.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, water, 2 tbsp oil and salt
knead and rise until doubled
Cook onions and pepper slowly in remaining oil until soft
cool and mix with tuna and tomato
Divide dough, roll two sheets
spread filling on one, cover with other, seal edges and vent top
brush with beaten egg
Bake at 190 C for 30 to 35 minutes until golden.
recipes.sides: Serve warm or at room temperature with salad.
recipes.substitutions: Use cooked shredded chicken instead of tuna.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours, use within 2 days and reheat until hot.
recipes.safety: Keep fish filling chilled before baking and cook pie through.

recipes.name: Garlic breadcrumbs with chorizo
recipes.description: Stale bread crumbs slowly toasted with garlic, paprika and optional sausage.
instructions: Crumble bread into small pieces and sprinkle lightly with water
cover 20 minutes
Warm oil in a wide pan
fry garlic and chorizo until fragrant, remove and reserve
Add crumbs to the pan and cook over low heat, stirring and turning until dry and golden
Return garlic and chorizo, add paprika and pepper and toss.
recipes.sides: Serve with grapes or fried egg.
recipes.substitutions: Use mushrooms instead of chorizo.
recipes.storage: Best fresh; refrigerate leftovers and reheat in a pan.
recipes.safety: Cook chorizo thoroughly and keep bread preparation clean.

recipes.name: Ham croquettes
recipes.description: Small crisp crumbed croquettes with a thick ham and milk filling.
instructions: Melt butter, stir in flour and cook 2 minutes; gradually whisk in warm milk until very thick and smooth.
Stir in ham, nutmeg and pepper; cook, stirring, until mixture pulls from pan. Spread on a tray, cover and chill until firm.
Shape into small cylinders; coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs. Chill 20 minutes.
Fry in 175 C oil in small batches until golden and hot inside; drain on a rack.
recipes.sides: Serve as a tapa with lemon and salad.
recipes.substitutions: Use cooked chicken or mushrooms instead of ham.
recipes.storage: Chill filling up to 24 hours; freeze shaped uncooked croquettes; fry from thawed.
recipes.safety: Keep filling refrigerated; cook croquettes fully and take care with hot oil.

recipes.name: Madrid chickpea and meat stew
recipes.description: A slow-cooked chickpea stew with vegetables and meat, served in courses.
instructions: Drain soaked chickpeas
put in a pot with beef, onion and water
simmer gently, skimming foam
Add chicken and chorizo after 60 minutes
cook until chickpeas and meats are tender, adding water if needed
Add carrots and potatoes for final 30 minutes
Season broth
serve it first, then chickpeas, vegetables and meat.
recipes.sides: Serve with cabbage and bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use canned chickpeas and shorten simmer; add them near the end.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat all components until steaming.
recipes.safety: Soak chickpeas in the refrigerator in warm weather; cook meat fully.

recipes.name: Milk-soaked cinnamon bread
recipes.description: Slices of bread soaked in sweetened milk, dipped in egg and lightly fried.
instructions: Warm milk with sugar and cinnamon
cool until lukewarm
Soak bread briefly on both sides without letting it fall apart
Dip in beaten egg
Fry in a shallow layer of oil over medium heat until golden on both sides
drain and coat in cinnamon sugar.
recipes.sides: Serve warm or chilled.
recipes.substitutions: Use orange zest in the milk.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: Cook egg coating through; handle hot oil carefully.

recipes.name: Murcian courgette and egg scramble
recipes.description: Soft courgette and onion cooked slowly, then folded with eggs.
instructions: Warm oil in a wide pan
cook onion gently until translucent
Add courgette and cook slowly, stirring now and then, until very soft and most liquid evaporates
Beat eggs with salt and pepper
pour into pan and stir over low heat until softly set
Remove from heat while still moist.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread as a tapa or light meal.
recipes.substitutions: Add a diced potato for a more filling dish.
recipes.storage: Serve promptly; refrigerate leftovers and use within 1 day.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs to a safe doneness; keep warm dishes out of room temperature.

recipes.name: Patatas bravas
recipes.description: Crisp potato cubes served with a smoky, mildly spicy tomato sauce.
instructions: Heat oven to 220 C. Toss potatoes with oil and salt; roast 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp and tender.
Cook onion in a little oil until soft; add garlic, paprika and chilli for 30 seconds. Stir in tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend sauce smooth, add vinegar and season. Spoon over hot potatoes and serve.
recipes.sides: Serve as a tapa with alioli.
recipes.substitutions: Use sweet paprika only for a mild sauce.
recipes.storage: Store sauce separately refrigerated up to 3 days; roast fresh potatoes for best texture.
recipes.safety: Keep sauce chilled and reheat until hot.

recipes.name: Rice with tomato and fried egg
recipes.description: White rice served with tomato sauce, fried egg and often fried banana.
instructions: Cook rice in salted water until tender, drain and keep covered
Soften onion and garlic in oil
add passata and simmer 15 minutes, season
Fry eggs and banana slices separately
serve each over rice with tomato sauce.
recipes.sides: Serve with a green salad.
recipes.substitutions: Use a fried plantain instead of banana or omit it.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate rice promptly and use within 24 hours; reheat once until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cool rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour; reheat thoroughly.

recipes.name: Spanish lentil stew
recipes.description: Brown lentils simmered with vegetables, paprika and optional chorizo.
instructions: Soften onion and carrots in olive oil
Stir in tomato and paprika for one minute
Add lentils, potato, bay and stock
simmer gently 35 to 45 minutes until lentils tender
remove bay and season.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread and salad.
recipes.substitutions: Add sliced chorizo with stock or omit for vegetarian stew.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Maintain a simmer and stir to prevent lentils sticking.

recipes.name: Spanish meatballs
recipes.description: Tender meatballs simmered in a tomato, onion and paprika sauce.
instructions: Mix mince, egg, breadcrumbs, half the garlic, parsley and seasoning
shape 16 balls
Brown meatballs in oil in batches
remove
Soften onion and remaining garlic, add paprika, tomatoes and stock
simmer 10 minutes
Return meatballs and simmer covered 15 minutes until cooked through.
recipes.sides: Serve with rice or bread.
recipes.substitutions: Use turkey mince and add a spoon of yogurt for moisture.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate promptly up to 3 days; reheat until steaming.
recipes.safety: Cook minced meatballs through the centre.

recipes.name: Spanish potato and tuna salad
recipes.description: Potatoes, carrots, peas, tuna and mayonnaise served chilled as a tapa.
instructions: Boil potatoes and carrots until just tender
add peas for final 3 minutes
drain and cool quickly
Boil eggs 10 minutes, cool, peel and chop
Mix vegetables, tuna, eggs, mayonnaise and lemon gently
Season and chill before serving.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread or olives.
recipes.substitutions: Use cooked beans instead of peas.
recipes.storage: Keep refrigerated and use within 24 hours.
recipes.safety: Use pasteurised mayonnaise; cool cooked vegetables rapidly and keep cold.

recipes.name: Spanish potato omelette
recipes.description: A thick omelette of slowly softened potatoes and onion bound with egg.
instructions: Warm oil in a non-stick pan
cook potatoes and onion gently, turning, until fully tender but not browned
Drain excess oil
beat eggs with salt and fold in potatoes
Return mixture to the pan and cook on low until edges set
Place a plate over pan, flip carefully, then slide tortilla back and cook until set to preferred doneness
Rest before slicing.
recipes.sides: Serve warm or at room temperature with salad.
recipes.substitutions: Omit onion if preferred.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate within 2 hours and use within 2 days.
recipes.safety: For vulnerable diners, cook egg mixture fully through rather than leaving it runny.

recipes.name: Spanish vegetable stew with egg
recipes.description: Slow-cooked peppers, courgette, onion and tomato served with a fried egg.
instructions: Dice vegetables evenly
Warm oil in a heavy pan and cook onion and peppers slowly until soft
Add courgette and cook 8 minutes
add tomatoes and sugar
simmer uncovered 25 minutes until thick
Season and serve topped with fried eggs.
recipes.sides: Serve with bread or roast potatoes.
recipes.substitutions: Use aubergine in place of some courgette.
recipes.storage: Refrigerate vegetables up to 3 days; cook eggs fresh.
recipes.safety: Cook eggs to safe doneness and chill vegetable leftovers promptly.

recipes.name: Tomato rubbed bread
recipes.description: Toasted bread rubbed with ripe tomato, garlic and olive oil.
instructions: Toast bread on both sides until crisp at the edges.
Rub the cut garlic lightly over each warm slice. Rub tomato flesh over bread so juice and pulp soak in.
Drizzle with olive oil and add a pinch of salt; serve immediately.
recipes.sides: Serve with cheese, omelette or cured ham.
recipes.substitutions: Use grated ripe tomato if tomatoes are difficult to rub.
recipes.storage: Assemble just before serving; do not store topped bread.
recipes.safety: Wash tomatoes before cutting.

recipes.name: Yogurt sponge cake
recipes.description: A simple tender cake measured with a yogurt pot, flavoured with lemon.
ingredients: 1 small pot plain yogurt, about 125 g
instructions: Heat oven to 180 C and grease a 20 cm cake tin
Whisk yogurt, eggs, sugar, oil and lemon zest
fold in flour and baking powder
Pour into tin and bake 30 to 35 minutes until risen and a skewer comes out clean
cool before slicing.
recipes.sides: Serve with fruit or coffee.
recipes.substitutions: Use orange zest or dairy-free yogurt.
recipes.storage: Store covered at room temperature for 2 days.
recipes.safety: Bake until centre is fully set.
